newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka development banks up on fresh buying.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka development banks up on fresh buying.

text.p: Shares of Sri Lanka's Development Finance Corporation and National Development Bank rose mostly on fresh local buying in early Wednesday trade, brokers said.
Development Finance rose 2.75 percent of 7.50 rupees to 280, National Development three percent or seven rupees to 240.
"Both shares are rising after the recent correction brought them down to more realistic levels," said a local broker who declined to be identified.

Brokers said earlier that sharp gains on Wall Street was likely to keep foreign buyers out of the market. Colombo stocks witnessed a correction last week after the index rose more than 15 percent in the previous six weeks.
